project_tracker_diagnostic: Goldenrod with many small yellow heads in broad panicles; usually less coarsely rough and often with narrower leaves than S. altissima.

project_inclusion.learning_reason: Common or useful Central Texas fall/white composite for field learning.

morphology_keys.leaves: Alternate, lanceolate, serrate, 3-nerved, generally thinner/less harsh than S. altissima.
morphology_keys.heads: Many small yellow heads in plume-like terminal inflorescences.
best_field_traits: compare with S. altissima for roughness/robustness

photo_strategy.selection_logic: Prefer curated taxon photos plus multiple views from one Central Texas/Texas observation.
